name: Tiefling
description: Tieflings are linked by blood to Fiends of the Lower Planes. Their abyssal, chthonic, or infernal legacy promises supernatural power but does not determine their outlook or destiny.

grants.name: Darkvision
grants.description: You have Darkvision out to 60 feet.

grants.name: Fiendish Legacy
grants.description: Choose a legacy. Its level 3 and 5 spells are always prepared; each can be cast once without a spell slot per Long Rest or with an appropriate spell slot.

options.name: Abyssal
options.description: Level 1: Poison resistance and Poison Spray. Level 3: Ray of Sickness. Level 5: Hold Person.

options.name: Chthonic
options.description: Level 1: Necrotic resistance and Chill Touch. Level 3: False Life. Level 5: Ray of Enfeeblement.

options.name: Infernal
options.description: Level 1: Fire resistance and Fire Bolt. Level 3: Hellish Rebuke. Level 5: Darkness.

grants.name: Legacy Spellcasting Ability
grants.description: Choose the spellcasting ability used by your Fiendish Legacy spells and Thaumaturgy.

grants.name: Otherworldly Presence
grants.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. It uses the spellcasting ability selected for Fiendish Legacy.
